# SOC-2

> OPA/Rego readiness-sensor example pack for SafetyMP / corporate-site-harness. Catalog + GitHub/org sensors emit evidence. Not a CPA opinion. Not SOC 2 certified.

This repository is a policy + sensor pack. Community and Copilot agents may run `./scripts/verify.sh`. They must not claim certification or implement a new factory program here.

## Docs

- [DESIGN-PIVOT.md](docs/DESIGN-PIVOT.md): sensor-pack positioning
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): verify contract and honesty rules
- [README.md](README.md): what this is / is not, quick start
- [Copilot instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md): never-do rules
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) / [.github/SECURITY.md](.github/SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting

## Verify

```bash
./scripts/verify.sh
```
